The title and strategy call this a 'type 2' deck (Episode I-only environment). The Coruscant-set printings are used for Coruscant, Tatooine, Control, Alter and Sense. The same author posted a near-identical list as 'EP1 LS senate' (DeckTech 19447) two days later.
Posted 'Senate' dested the Light Coruscant: Galactic Senate (the draft had the Dark page).

Posted 'All 4 of thePolitical Effects' (under 'Red stuff (17)') dested the four Light Political Effects printed through Coruscant: Ascertaining The Truth, I Will Not Defer, Plea To The Court and The Gravest Of Circumstances.

Posted 'Yoda, JCM' dested Yoda, Senior Council Member; 'Qui-Gons stick' dested Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (Tatooine; Qui-Gon's Lightsaber is Reflections III, released after this post); 'Horax Ryder' dested Horox Ryyder; 'Naboo Pilot' dested Naboo Fighter Pilot; 'Naboo Fighter' dested Naboo Defense Fighter; 'Valorum' dested Supreme Chancellor Valorum; 'Sen. Palpatine' dested Senator Palpatine.
Mindful Of The Future is posted once in the starting section and x2 under 'Red stuff' (3 total, as published).
